objectif: Quatre plateaux télé entièrement illustrés dans le style des références, avec surfaces de combat de face et chutes mortelles.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final full-screen illustrated game arena, widescreen 16:9 landscape, high resolution 2048x1152 preferred.
Input image 1 is the user's art-direction reference. Adapt its visual richness, painted cartoon / French political caricature style, confident ink outlines, polished hand-painted shading, lustrous materials, warm amber and electric blue stage lighting, elegant theatrical architecture, and lavish coherent studio atmosphere. The output is one complete continuous illustration of a TV studio, edge to edge, not a collage, no floating rectangular image windows, no generic black void, no diagram.
Camera: straight-on 2D fighting-game front view. Background studio architecture may have depth, but ALL playable platform top edges are straight horizontal lines in the SAME side-view plane. Show a shallow top surface and richly illustrated thick facades / metal supports below. No elliptical walkways, no isometric fighting floor. Preserve beauty and illustrative detail comparable to the reference.
Gameplay composition: clear readable bright platform rims, unoccupied horizontal fight lanes, obvious open gaps between platform slabs where a fighter can fall. Props and cameras stay behind the fighting line or outside its ends. The stage has audience seated behind, broadcast camera rigs at outer edges, truss lights overhead, and cinematic beams. The area below the stage contains beautifully painted lower studio machinery, reflected colored light and distant audience, giving a real sense of height: not a uniform black background, and no additional solid walkable floor or bridge under the specified holes. Main walking line at exactly 73% of image height from the top; keep platform edges clear and unwavering. Upper usable platforms are at about 53% of image height. No standing fighters, no UI, no health bars, no words, no numbers, no arrows, no labels, no watermark. Do not add unlisted playable ledges. Do not cover the fighting line with sofas, lecterns, or spectators.
Theme: lavish Élysée presidential debate from the reference. Three tall giant blue / ivory / red political caricature banners integrated into the architecture, monumental glowing Élysée palace backdrop, side screens with charts and coins, French and European flags, stacks of documents, gold trim, blue glass and cream armchairs behind the stage. Rich elegant cobalt / amber palette.
EXACT foreground topology: three main stage slabs on one straight horizontal walking line at y=73%. Left slab extends x=7% to34%, central slab x=39% to61%, right slab x=66% to93%. Leave real visible open 5%-wide death gaps between them and open space at the far left and far right. The central slab is equally high as the side slabs, not an ellipse. Two smaller horizontal balcony slabs at y=53%, from x=18% to32% and x=68% to82%, using the same ornate blue-and-gold platform art. No large foreground audience obscuring the holes. Empty fight lane in front of all furniture.

retouches.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target.
Keep this gorgeous illustrated presidential TV studio EXACTLY the same: same painterly caricature style, framing, size, lighting, portraits, Élysée palace, audience, cameras, blue/gold/cream materials, details and two raised balconies.
Change ONLY the two gaps between the THREE main foreground platforms. They must be unambiguous deadly open shafts for a 2D fighting game. Widen the two gaps slightly to roughly 5% of image width each by shortening only the INNER ends of the left and right main slabs; leave the central slab intact. In BOTH gaps, remove the thin shiny pale horizontal walkway / stage floor behind the slabs at the height of the walking surfaces. The gaps must look completely open, deep vertical drops with distant lower studio machinery and colored light visible far below, with no connecting walkway, no bridge, no hidden floor, no railing crossing the open shaft. Maintain clear flat horizontal tops of all three slabs on the SAME height and SAME 2D fighting plane. Preserve every other part of the illustration without recropping or rearranging anything. No text or arrows, no new objects, no black overlays. Rich fully painted scene all the way to the bottom.
